facts.fact: Angola's Ministry of Justice and Human Rights runs a Universalisation of Civil Registration and Identity Cards Programme, whose plan aims to give identity cards to all adult citizens listed in the civil registry database by December 2026, per National Director Aristides Marques.

AGO.note: Only a count of cards issued (17,166,000) is given, not people enrolled; a card count is not recorded.
Children apply for identity cards for school enrolment; no number given at birth registration is stated.

facts.fact: Angola's National Director of Registries and Notary Services said all 21 provinces have installed capacity to issue and print identity cards locally, with national daily production raised from 12,000 to 60,000 cards after technological upgrades.

AGO.note: No public register keyed on the ID number is stated; the voter registration update is only said to benefit from the card drive.

facts.fact: Angola's National Director of Registries and Notary Services Aristides Marques said 17,166,000 national identity cards (BI) have been issued at home and in the diaspora.
